name: Douglas North Datacentre
notes: Manx Telecom's official Isle of Man datacentre site lists Douglas North as one of its twin Tier 3-standard data centres, with 8,232 sq ft, 280 racks and 3 data halls. DCD reported the dedicated data centre division launch in 2024.

name: Greenhill Data Centre
notes: Manx Telecom's official Isle of Man datacentre site lists Greenhill as its second Tier 3-standard data centre, with 7,599 sq ft, 211 racks and 2 data halls. DCD reported the facility as part of Manx Telecom's dedicated data centre unit.

name: Continent 8 Isle of Man Data Centre
notes: Continent 8's official location page describes Isle of Man data centre/hosting capabilities and regulated cloud/backup services. A Continent 8 company article says the Douglas Isle of Man data centre and headquarters opened in 2008 after an initial GBP5m investment; Digital Isle of Man lists Continent 8 as a local data centre provider.

name: The Isle of Man Datacentre
notes: Digital Isle of Man lists Domicilium (IOM) Limited at The Isle of Man Datacentre; Domicilium's own site describes state-of-the-art data centres, cloud and network services. Earlier Data Center Knowledge coverage described Domicilium building a 22,000 sq ft centre in Ronaldsway.

name: The Dataport
notes: Netcetera's current site says it owns and operates The Dataport, a Tier 3 Isle of Man datacentre. DataCenterMap lists The Dataport in Ballasalla with 10 MW and 700+ rack hosting capacity. Confidence is lowered because Manx Technology Group's February 2026 market note says Netcetera exited the datacentre market in late 2025, leaving four datacentres.

name: Wi-Manx Heywood House / Noventre
notes: DataCenterMap lists Wi-Manx Heywood House in Douglas as a data centre. DCD reported in 2016 that Wi-Manx provided colocation and cloud services through one data center on the island. Noventre's 2025 rebrand note says Noventre Home replaced the Wi-Manx brand; current official Noventre pages emphasize managed IT/connectivity rather than a physical data centre, so status is left unknown.
